thread:
mina: Heads-up: partner 'Cetus' onboarding showing mixed failures — SSO succeeds but SCIM creates sometimes return 422 invalid_extid and some users missing RBAC role mapping. Opening here.
zane: When did this start? any changelogs from Cetus?
kyle: I saw it at 14:02 UTC. SCIM logs show two classes: 'invalid_envelope_version' from KMS layer and 'role_not_found' when applying RBAC.
kms-bot: [14:03:10] kms.decrypt failed key=cetus/extid reason=EnvelopeVersionUnsupported request=req_cet_11
mina: Cetus told us they rotated KMS alias yesterday to alias/cetus-v2 and used their new wrapper. We only accept 'redwood-kms-v1'.
zane: RBAC role issue — they renamed role 'app_admin' -> 'app:admin' in their provisioning pipeline. Our role-mapper expects exact match on urn:redwood:attr:role values.
kyle: Two independent problems but same onboarding window. For quick fix we can: (1) return clearer 400 for unsupported envelopes; (2) temporarily map 'app:admin' -> 'app_admin' on tenant mapping.
platform-oncall: I can set a tenant mapping override: ``/ops tenant-config set cetus role_alias.app:admin=app_admin --expires 24h``
audit-bot: [14:07:02] audit.event USER_CREATE_FAILURE tenant=cetus reason=EnvelopeVersionUnsupported actor=provisioner svc=req_cet_11
zane: Important: do NOT accept unknown envelopes. We should reject with actionable text: "unsupported envelope version; please use redwood-kms-v1 (docs://integrations/kms)". Add audit id for SOC correlation.
kyle: I'll add metric scim.extid.envelope_unsupported and an explicit 400 payload. Estimated 1 dev day. I'll open SEC-3401.
mina: For RBAC mapping, tenant override will reduce impact while we ask Cetus to stop renaming roles. Also add a mapping suggestion to the console UI for integrators. SEC-3402.
platform-oncall: Override applied. auth/role failures dropped 28->2 in 30m. KMS decrypts unchanged.
kms-bot: [14:29:48] scim.create succeeded user=cetus/lee req=req_cet_33 note=extid-wrapped-ok
zane: Cetus ops responded: their deploy accidentally switched to internal wrapper v2; they're rewrapping extids and will resend. They also acknowledged role name change came from a templating update.
kyle: Post-incident: (a) parser/ingest must validate envelope header strictly and include guidance in response (SEC-3401), (b) add regression test for role alias mapping and console hint (SEC-3402), (c) add an onboarding checklist item to verify KMS alias and role canonicalization (SEC-3403).
mina: I'll compile artifacts and notify SOC; include audit ids from audit-bot.
audit-bot: [14:45:02] audit.event CONFIG_OVERRIDE tenant=cetus actor=platform-oncall note=temporary-role-alias
platform-oncall: Override will auto-expire 24h. Extend if needed.
zane: Thanks team. Once Cetus resends, we'll revert the override and close. :thumbsup:
